title: Best SharePoint Ticketing Systems
summary: Compare the best SharePoint ticketing systems for IT support. Review key features, integrations, and tools to manage support tickets efficiently.
body_markdown:
Organizations using Microsoft 365 often manage internal support requests across SharePoint, Teams, and email. Turning these requests into trackable workflows helps IT, HR, and operations teams manage support more efficiently.


As support requirements grow, ticketing systems increasingly incorporate automation, self-service, and centralized request management. The ITSM market is projected to grow from $17.4 billion in 2026 to[$44.6 billion](https://www.grandviewresearch.com/industry-analysis/it-service-management-market-report?ref=unthread.io) by 2033, reflecting demand for these capabilities.


SharePoint ticketing options range from native solutions that store data within Microsoft 365 tenants to enterprise ITSM platforms with SharePoint integrations. Organizations using Slack alongside Microsoft 365 can also consider[Slack-native ticketing solutions](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) for managing internal support across their existing tools.


## **Key Takeaways**


- Centralized ticket management organizes internal requests across SharePoint, Teams, email, and other channels through structured assignment and resolution workflows.
- Unthread centralizes internal support across Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and employee portals, providing structured ticketing,[automated workflows](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) , and analytics for IT, HR, and operations teams.
- Data storage and deployment vary across platforms, with some storing tickets within Microsoft 365 tenants and others connecting through integrations.
- Custom SharePoint ticketing workflows require ongoing maintenance, particularly for email threading, SLA tracking, and automated routing.
- Unthread's purpose-built AI agent helps resolve routine requests, while its[self-learning knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) identifies recurring questions and opportunities to improve internal documentation.


## **What to Look for in a SharePoint Ticketing System**


Internal support teams have different requirements than customer-facing help desks. An IT access request, HR benefits question, or facilities maintenance ticket needs structured routing, appropriate privacy controls, and clear ownership. At the same time, employees expect fast responses from the tools they already use daily.


A strong SharePoint ticketing system should help teams:


- Convert emails, Teams messages, and portal submissions into trackable tickets
- Route requests by department, priority, urgency, or employee context
- Maintain data sovereignty with ticket storage in your Microsoft 365 tenant
- Automate recurring Tier 1 requests through workflows and self-service
- Build a reusable[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) from resolved requests
- Track SLAs and ownership across IT, HR, and operations queues
- Connect with HRIS, identity, and business systems through relevant[integration capabilities](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io)


The most effective systems let internal teams keep everyday request intake simple while adding the structure needed for accountability and reporting.


## **1) Unthread: Purpose-Built AI Agent for Internal Support Beyond SharePoint**


[Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) turns Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and employee portals into a structured internal help desk. Rather than requiring employees to submit requests through SharePoint forms, Unthread lets employees ask for help where they already work while IT, HR, and operations teams maintain full visibility and control.


### **Where This Approach Fits**


This model works when:


- Employees primarily communicate in Slack rather than Teams or SharePoint
- Support requests span multiple departments (IT, HR, Finance, Legal, Facilities)
- Organizations want[automated workflows](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) without building Power Automate flows from scratch
- Teams need[analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) to identify request trends and automation opportunities


### **Key Capabilities**


- [AI agent for support](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) that helps automatically resolve routine tickets
- Multi-channel ticket intake across Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and portals
- [Private ticketing](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) for sensitive HR matters
- [Pre-built integrations](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io) with key platforms including Jira, Salesforce, and ServiceNow
- [Self-learning knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) that detects repeat questions and flags outdated documentation
- Real-time analytics for support volume, SLA tracking, and recurring issue patterns


### **Integration Flexibility**


For organizations using SharePoint alongside other workplace tools, Unthread supports Microsoft Teams and offers integration capabilities for connecting internal support with existing systems.


Its cross-platform approach allows employees to submit requests through familiar communication channels while support teams manage structured ticketing and automation.


## **2) Helpdesk 365**


Helpdesk 365 from HR365 is a SharePoint Framework (SPFx) ticketing system that runs within your Microsoft 365 tenant.


### **Platform Overview**


Helpdesk 365 stores all ticket data in SharePoint lists within your tenant rather than external cloud infrastructure. This approach addresses data sovereignty requirements and keeps sensitive employee information within the organization's environment.


### **Key Capabilities**


- AI-powered ticket routing and automatic assignment based on content analysis
- Native Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook integration
- SPFx architecture ensuring all data stays in customer tenant
- Bubble 365 AI chatbot for 24/7 automated ticket creation
- Custom workflows for approvals, escalations, and multi-department routing


### **Pricing and Considerations**


Helpdesk 365 lists its Standard plan starting at $19.99 per user per month, billed annually, with a minimum of five agents. Organizations should review the vendor's current pricing and deployment requirements before selecting a plan.


## **3) Crow Canyon NITRO Help Desk**


Crow Canyon NITRO Help Desk provides enterprise service management capabilities within Microsoft 365 environments.


### **Platform Overview**


NITRO Help Desk operates as a single-tenant solution with zero external cloud dependencies. This architecture supports data residency and compliance requirements.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Complete platform deployment within the customer's M365 tenant
- NITRO Engage Teams app for chat-based ticket creation
- AI-powered KB Copilot for self-service deflection
- NITRO Studio no-code workflow engine for visual process design
- Custom fields, forms, and approval chains


### **Pricing and Considerations**


Crow Canyon requires contacting their team for pricing quotes. Organizations should evaluate the level of SharePoint expertise available internally, as NITRO's customization capabilities require technical configuration.


## **4) SP Marketplace IT Helpdesk**


SP Marketplace IT Helpdesk is a SharePoint-based ticketing platform that operates as a Platform-as-a-Service within Microsoft 365 environments.


### **Platform Overview**


The platform uses a SharePoint list-based architecture for ticket storage and management. Ticket data remains within the organization's Microsoft 365 environment, following its existing SharePoint infrastructure.


### **Key Capabilities**


- PaaS deployment model within the customer's M365 tenant
- Integration with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint
- Asset management and knowledge base included
- No-code customization for business users
- No per-ticket fees with team-size pricing model


### **Pricing and Considerations**


SP Marketplace requires contacting their team for pricing quotes. The platform offers SharePoint integration with traditional interface design.


## **5) SharePoint Lists + Power Automate**


SharePoint Lists and Power Automate can be configured to create custom ticketing workflows within Microsoft 365 environments. This approach involves building and maintaining ticket management processes using existing SharePoint components.


### **Platform Overview**


This approach uses SharePoint Lists for ticket storage and Power Automate for workflow configuration. Implementation and ongoing maintenance are handled internally, with functionality depending on the organization's configuration.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Custom SharePoint Lists for ticket storage and tracking
- Power Automate flows for routing, notifications, and escalations
- Customizable ticket fields and workflows
- Integration with existing Microsoft 365 components
- Configuration and maintenance managed internally


### **What Teams Should Consider**


Building a SharePoint-based ticketing system involves configuring ticket ownership, routing, permissions, email handling, reporting, and service targets. As Collab365 notes, these requirements extend beyond creating basic ticket forms.


## **6) Tikit by Cireson**


Tikit is a Microsoft Teams-native ticketing system that provides ticket management functionality within Microsoft 365 environments.


### **Platform Overview**


Tikit uses Microsoft Teams as its primary interface for creating, tracking, and managing internal support tickets. Its ticketing workflows operate through Teams-based interactions and Microsoft 365 integrations.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Ticket creation from Microsoft Teams messages
- AI-based ticket deflection using Azure OpenAI
- Adaptive Cards for configuring intake forms
- Separate Support Bot and Agent Bot components
- Ticket management across IT, HR, Facilities, and Finance


### **Pricing and Considerations**


Tikit requires contacting their team for pricing information. The platform includes SSO via Microsoft Entra ID for both employees and agents.


## **7) Plumsail HelpDesk**


Plumsail HelpDesk is a SharePoint-based ticketing platform that supports email-to-ticket conversion and Microsoft Teams integration.


### **Platform Overview**


Plumsail uses SharePoint for ticket management and supports email-based request intake. The platform also provides a Microsoft Teams widget that embeds helpdesk functionality within a Teams tab.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Email-to-ticket conversion with conversation threading
- Knowledge base integration
- Microsoft Teams widget for helpdesk access
- SharePoint-based ticket storage
- Workflow automation for ticket management


### **Pricing and Considerations**


Plumsail requires contacting the vendor for pricing information. The platform uses a SharePoint-based architecture with configurable ticketing workflows and Microsoft Teams integration.


## **8) HarePoint HelpDesk**


HarePoint HelpDesk supports SharePoint Server on-premises deployments alongside SharePoint Online.


### **Platform Overview**


HarePoint provides ticket management functionality for SharePoint Server and SharePoint Online environments. The platform uses SPFx custom forms and SharePoint permissions for managing ticket intake and access controls.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Support for both SharePoint Online and SharePoint Server
- SPFx custom forms for ticket intake
- SharePoint permissions inheritance for access control
- Ticket lifecycle management within SharePoint lists
- Power Automate workflow triggers for ticket events


### **Pricing and Considerations**


HarePoint requires contacting the vendor for licensing information. Deployment and configuration requirements depend on the organization's SharePoint environment and infrastructure.


## **9) Desk365**


Desk365 is a Microsoft Teams-native help desk that provides ticket management functionality within Microsoft 365 environments.


### **Platform Overview**


Desk365 uses Microsoft Teams for employee request intake, ticket assignment, and service management workflows. The platform supports ticket tracking through Teams-based interactions and configurable forms.


### **Key Capabilities**


- Separate Support Bot and Agent Bot components
- Ticket creation from Microsoft Teams messages
- Microsoft Entra ID SSO for portal access
- Custom ticket forms and fields
- SLA tracking and reporting


### **Pricing and Considerations**


Desk365 offers a free tier for up to three agents, alongside paid plans. The platform is available through the Microsoft App Store and requires configuration within the organization's Microsoft Teams environment.


## **10) SysAid**


SysAid provides full ITSM capabilities for organizations that need incident, problem, change, and asset management alongside basic ticketing.


### **Platform Overview**


SysAid provides IT organizations with ITIL-aligned service management. The Teams integration functions as an add-on to the core ITSM system.


### **Key Capabilities**


- AI Copilot chatbot for Teams-based interactions
- Intelligent categorization and auto-routing using generative AI
- Approval workflows accessible within Teams
- Full incident, problem, change, and asset management
- Enterprise-grade reporting and analytics


### **Pricing and Considerations**


SysAid requires contacting their team for pricing information. Organizations should review whether the full ITSM feature set justifies the price point for their requirements.


## **11) ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus**


ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus provides ITIL-aligned workflows, SLA management, asset management, and integration capabilities for SharePoint and Microsoft 365 environments.


### **Platform Overview**


ServiceDesk Plus supports incident, problem, change, and asset management through structured ITSM workflows. SharePoint functions as an integration point rather than the platform's primary ticketing interface.


### **Key Capabilities**


- ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and release management
- SLA escalation paths with timer tracking
- Azure AD authentication support
- Extensive reporting and compliance features
- Asset discovery and CMDB capabilities


### **Pricing and Considerations**


ManageEngine requires contacting the vendor for pricing information. The platform's deployment and configuration requirements depend on the organization's ITSM processes and integration needs.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **Can SharePoint be used as a standalone ticketing system?**


Yes. SharePoint Lists and Power Automate can support basic ticket tracking, routing, and notifications. However, advanced functionality such as email threading, SLA tracking, and reporting requires additional configuration and ongoing maintenance.


For internal support across communication channels,[Slack-native ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) provides another approach to managing employee requests through structured workflows.


### **What are the benefits of integrating a dedicated helpdesk with SharePoint?**


A dedicated helpdesk can introduce structured ticket management, automated routing, SLA tracking, and reporting into internal support processes. These capabilities help teams coordinate requests across departments and communication channels.


Unthread's[workflow automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) supports this broader approach by connecting ticketing processes with other business systems.


### **How does AI improve ticket resolution in a SharePoint-integrated environment?**


AI helps automate ticket categorization, routing, and responses using knowledge base content. These capabilities can reduce manual handling of recurring internal requests.


Unthread's[purpose-built AI agent](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) supports these workflows across departments, with its Lemonade case study reporting approximately[40% automatic ticket resolution](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance.


### **Which security considerations are important for SharePoint ticketing systems?**


Key considerations include data residency, access controls, encryption, audit logging, and compliance requirements such as SOC 2 and HIPAA.


Sensitive employee requests also require appropriate privacy controls, particularly for HR workflows involving payroll, benefits, and personal information.


Features such as Unthread's[private HR ticketing](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) help manage these requests through confidential support conversations.


### **Is it possible to automate workflows between SharePoint and a ticketing system?**


Yes. SharePoint-based workflows can use Power Automate for ticket routing, approvals, escalations, and notifications. Automation can also extend to other business systems through integrations and configurable workflows.


For internal support operations, Unthread's[Automation Builder](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) supports cross-department routing, approvals, and recurring request management.
